command:
set +e
short_pw=$(printf 'Aa1!'; awk 'BEGIN { printf "qwertyu" }')
fewclass_pw=$(awk 'BEGIN { printf "abcdefghijkl" }')
strong_pw="$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Z' </dev/urandom | head -c 4)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'a-z' </dev/urandom | head -c 6)$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc '0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 4)!"
short_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$short_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); short_rc=$?
fewclass_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$fewclass_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); fewclass_rc=$?
strong_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$strong_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); strong_rc=$?
unset short_pw fewclass_pw strong_pw
printf 'short-four-classes rc=%s result=%s\n' "$short_rc" "$short_out"
printf 'twelve-one-class rc=%s result=%s\n' "$fewclass_rc" "$fewclass_out"
printf 'long-four-classes rc=%s score=%s\n' "$strong_rc" "$strong_out"
[ "$short_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$fewclass_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$strong_rc" -eq 0 ]
